page_title: LAZ 0-6 INT | Lazio v Inter 16/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yann Sommer intercepts the ball.
90+2' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 0 - 6 Goal - 0:6! Henrikh Mkhitaryan laid the ball off to Marcus Thuram (Inter), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
88' The corner from Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is intercepted by the defence.
84' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
81' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Federico Dimarco is replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Inter).
81' Substitution. Gaetano Castrovilli (Lazio) on for Mattia Zaccagni.
80' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) attempts to discuss the decision with Daniele Chiffi, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
80' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Lazio earn a corner.

77' 0 - 5 Federico Dimarco produces a sweet pass and picks out Carlos Augusto (Inter) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:5!
75' Matteo Darmian (Inter) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniele Chiffi didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
74' Here comes a substitution. Nicolo Barella is given a rest as he is replaced by Piotr Zielinski (Inter).
72' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
71' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
69' Nicolo Barella (Inter) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
67' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
67' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

65' What a poor attempt! Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kristjan Asllani (Inter) comes onto the pitch so that Hakan Calhanoglu can be given a rest.
63' Substitution. Carlos Augusto (Inter) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Alessandro Bastoni walks off.
61' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:5.
57' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Gustav Isaksen and he is replaced by Loum Tchaouna (Lazio).
57' Pedro will be replaced by Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).

53' 0 - 4 It's a goal! Denzel Dumfries (Inter) makes it 0:4. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Alessandro Bastoni and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Ivan Provedel was helpless.
51' 0 - 3 Goal! Hakan Calhanoglu slips it to Nicolo Barella (Inter) on the edge of the box and he finds the top left corner with a great effort. The score is 0:3.
50' Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul after Marcus Thuram (Inter) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marco Baroni gives a chance to Manuel Lazzari and Samuel Gigot (Lazio) is off.
46' The game is over for Yann Bisseck (Inter). Matteo Darmian comes on for the second half.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Chiffi starts the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

45' 0 - 2 Federico Dimarco (Inter) meets a perfect cross from Denzel Dumfries deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces a low shot into the middle of the goal. The score has changed to 0:2.
45' The resulting corner from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) comes to nothing.
44' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Yann Bisseck (Inter) gets booked.
41' 0 - 1 Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Ivan Provedel to move before slotting the ball low into the middle of the goal!
41' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
40' The main referee, Daniele Chiffi, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) is given a yellow card for dissent.
40' The players claim that Samuel Gigot (Lazio) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. The referee gives a penalty kick to Inter!!

39' Play continues despite the shouts by some Inter players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
39' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
35' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
34' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul after Pedro (Lazio) hacks down one of his opponents.
31' Today's referee Daniele Chiffi rightly decides to book Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) for his harsh tackle.
28' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mario Gila leaves the pitch and Samuel Gigot (Lazio) comes on.
24' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is yellow-carded.
19' Nicolo Barella (Inter) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
11' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Yann Sommer was alert and made a comfortable save.
9' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
8' Flag up against Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
7' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Yann Sommer makes a comfortable save.
5' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniele Chiffi signals.
4' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
3' A pass by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Lazio will take the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
